'''Salford''' is a city located near [[Manchester]], [[England]], that appears in {{L61}}. A recording studio located in Salford also makes a cameo appearance in [[The Introduction]] movie of {{SA}}.

Due to the entire Manchester map not having separate named zones and being treated as a unique zone, the area is referred to as '''Southwest Manchester''' on the HUD.

==Description==
===2D Universe===
It is located in the southwest portion of the Manchester map, separated from the city itself. The small portion of Salford present in the game is depicted as a small residential area. The neighbourhood uses models and textures from [[Camberwell]] and [[Chelsea]] from the [[London]] map.

==Influence==
It is based on the real-life city of {{WP|Salford}}.<ref>{{URL|https://i.pinimg.com/736x/b2/c3/a0/b2c3a05ca0d9debb0e2894103163519e--salford-slums.jpg|Salford slums in the 1960s}}</ref>
